CONGRATULATIONS, GUY![image]Thank you, Cape Cod Veterinary Specialists![image][image]This morning was extra special in the Fightin’ Fifth as I got to surprise my longtime friend, constituent, and fellow Big Nick’s Rider, Guy Cosgrove, a Midmark Veterinary Planning and Design Specialist, with a Massachusetts House of Representatives citation recognizing his 38 years of helping build and improve veterinary offices and hospitals all across America.[image][image]We met at the beautiful new addition to Cape Cod Veterinary Specialists in Buzzards Bay, right underneath the Bourne Bridge. This 24/7 animal hospital is doubling in size to care for even more sick and injured animals.[image][image]This is the hospital that saved K9 Nero and hosts the annual canine blood drive every April 12th in memory of fallen Yarmouth Police Department K9 Sergeant Sean M. Gannon and in honor of his dedicated partner, K9 Nero.[image][image]I’ll never forget what they’ve done for Nero and my own pets when they needed help. It was great to see this expansion firsthand and hear about what’s coming next.[image][image]Congratulations, Guy! And thank you to Dr. Louisa Rahilly and her entire dedicated team at Cape Cod Veterinary Specialists for everything you do for our four-legged family members.[image][image]Proud to see this great project happening right here in the Fightin’ Fifth![image][image]Lots more GOOD to come![image]🇺🇸😊🐕🐈👏🏻[image]#RepX #Fightin5th #ServiceBeforeSelf #ProudAmerican #CommonSenseLeadership #CCVS #Animals #K9Nero #Bourne #CapeCod #Massachusetts #MaPoli[image]Cape Cod Veterinary Specialists[image]Midmark Veterinary[image]Yarmouth Police Dept.[image]Nero Our K9 Hero[image]Bourne Police Department[image]Yarmouth Police Foundation

GOOD MORNING AND HAPPY TUESDAY![image][image]GREAT NEWS! The K9 license plates are arriving and hitting the road! My good friend Joe just got his, and it looks great![image][image]Every plate features SG for Sean Gannon and a picture of Nero, our hero, who is still alive and doing well! OVER 5,000 PLATES HAVE BEEN ORDERED![image][image]The proceeds help care for our retired police and military K9s across the Commonwealth and support Dakota’s Law and Nero’s Law. A great way to show love and respect for our four-legged heroes![image][image]JOIN US THIS SUNDAY at 9 AM at Bourne High School for the first-ever K9 PTSD 5K Road Race! There’s still time to order your plate, too![image][image]Have a TERRIFIC TUESDAY! God bless! GOOD MORNING, HAPPY WEDNESDAY IN THE FIGHTIN’ FIFTH![image][image]It’s going to be a beautiful Cape Cod day![image][image]A reminder that this Sunday, October 18th, is the FIRST EVER K9 5K in Bourne, starting and ending at Bourne High School.[image][image]At 9 AM, before the race, we’ll have a special ceremony honoring the K9s of the Commonwealth, with beautiful awards being presented, including one for K9 Nero. This ceremony is OPEN TO THE PUBLIC![image][image]The K9 5K will help support retired police and military K9s and the new K9 PTSD Center planned for Bourne.[image][image]If you can, please join us Sunday morning for the ceremony and stay for the 5K run or walk. Let’s do everything we can to honor and take care of these four-legged heroes![image][image]God bless. REMEMBERING MY FRIEND SEAN [image][image]Today, I attended the service for my friend Sean Andrew Whelahan at Nickerson-Bourne Funeral Home in Sandwich. It was a difficult day, but also a chance to celebrate a life that meant so much to so many people.[image][image]Sean was a devoted husband to Tara, a loving father to Kian and Rylee, a successful business owner of 6A Tours and Kian ’n Rylee’s, and a true friend. He had a great sense of humor and a special gift for bringing people together. Sean could walk into a room full of strangers and leave with a room full of friends. He was also a father figure and mentor to many.[image][image]What makes this loss especially difficult is that I last communicated with Sean just two weeks ago. He was planning to bring a van full of WW II veterans from Mashpee to Logan Airport at 4 a.m. so they could take a Hero Flight to Washington, D.C., to visit the World War II Memorial. He was also going to pick them up at 11 p.m. and bring them home. All of it as a volunteer, giving his time to honor those who served our country.[image][image]THAT WAS SEAN. Always thinking about others, always willing to help, and always showing up for those who needed him.[image][image]Sean cared deeply about our veterans and their families. I’m proud that the US Marine Corporal Nicholas G. Xiarhos Memorial Fund was one of the organizations close to his heart.[image][image]My heart goes out to Tara, Kian, Rylee, and all of Sean’s family and friends. He touched so many lives, and he will be missed by all who knew him.[image][image]Rest in peace, my friend. Thank you for your friendship, your kindness, and everything you did for others.[image][image]God bless you, Sean. We’ll take it from here. 🇺🇸❤️😔🙏🏻🫡[image]#RepX #Fightin5th #ProudAmerican #ServiceBeforeSelf #CommonSenseLeadership #Sandwich #CapeCod #Massachusetts #MaPoli[image]6A Tours and Transport[image]Nickerson-Bourne Funeral Home
